appearance.languageHelp: Applies immediately and is saved to your account.
appearance.collapseHelp: Show a slim icon rail instead of the full sidebar.
appearance.reduceMotionHelp: Turn off animations and transitions. Your system preference is always respected.

chat.enterToSendHelp: When off, Enter adds a new line and Ctrl/⌘+Enter sends.
chat.streamHelp: Show text as it is generated. When off, the full answer appears at once.
chat.autoTitleHelp: After the first reply, ask the model for a short title. Otherwise the first message is used.
chat.showReasoningHelp: Display the thought process of reasoning models in a collapsible section.
chat.systemPromptHelp: Used by every conversation unless it sets its own. It is sent to the model as written, so you may write it in any language.
chat.systemPromptPlaceholder: You are a concise, helpful assistant.
chat.paramsHelp: Leave a field empty to use the server's own default. Parameters are only sent when the connection supports them.
chat.paramsHelpProvider: Leave a field empty to use the server's own default. Parameters are only sent when the connection supports them (checked against {{name}}).

documents.attachmentsHelp: Files are read on this server; the extracted text is sent to the model with your message.
documents.maxCharsHelp: Longer documents are truncated; use Knowledge for large files.
documents.knowledgeHelp: Keyword search works offline out of the box. Add a local embedding model for semantic search (e.g. llama-server started with --embeddings, or Ollama's nomic-embed-text).
documents.embeddingModelHelp: Re-index existing documents after changing it.

data.point1: Your conversations, documents and settings are stored in a local SQLite database on this server and are visible only to your account.
data.point2: No telemetry, analytics or tracking. The interface loads no external fonts, scripts or styles.
data.point3: Prompts are only sent to the model connections you use.
data.exportHelp: A portable JSON file with your conversations, prompts and settings. API keys are never exported.
data.backupHelp: Administrators only: a complete copy of the database, including every account, connection and knowledge collection.
data.restoreBody: All current data for every account will be replaced with the contents of “{{name}}”.
data.deleteConversationsBody: Every one of your conversations and messages will be permanently deleted.
data.deleteAllBody: Your conversations, prompts, knowledge collections, uploads, personal connections and settings will be permanently deleted. Your account remains.

about.tagline: A calm, local-first workspace for your own language models.
